newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency mark et closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency mark et closing report.

text.p: The positive mood in Europe as well as Sweden continued with slightly falling debt yields. The crown was just about unchanged in the afternoon after reversing early gains.
"The trend from the past days continues. Europe is strong and we are doing somewhat better than Germany," one dealer said.
One trader referred to the American investment bank Goldman Sachs, which has recommended its clients to increase the weight of Sweden in their bond portfolios.
